description: React component for displaying, searching, copying, and deleting notes in a notes management page, with accessibility features and integration with notes repository and auth context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of notes from the repository, handles errors, and updates state.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles the search form submission to reload notes based on query.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID and updates the list, with error handling.

methods.name: copyNote
methods.description: Copies note content to clipboard and shows success or error toast.
